notes: Organization register for SRM Watch. Seed entries below are illustrative samples; the scanner/analyst pipeline expands this over time. type: academic | government | intergovernmental | ngo | civil-society | commercial | funder. stance: pro-research | cautionary | opposed | neutral | pro-deployment.

organizations.name: The Degrees Initiative
organizations.description: UK-based non-profit that builds the capacity of researchers in the Global South to evaluate solar radiation modification and centres developing-country perspectives in the debate.

organizations.name: SilverLining
organizations.description: US non-profit advocating for research and governance of near-term climate interventions, including funding for atmospheric science and model intercomparison.

organizations.name: Carnegie Climate Governance Initiative (C2G)
organizations.description: Impartial initiative working to catalyse the creation of effective governance for climate-altering approaches, in particular SRM and large-scale carbon dioxide removal.

organizations.name: Make Sunsets
organizations.description: Commercial start-up selling 'cooling credits' tied to releasing reflective sulfate aerosols via balloons; a frequent focal point in debates about unilateral, unregulated deployment.

organizations.name: Convention on Biological Diversity (CBD)
organizations.description: UN convention whose 2010 decision established a widely-cited de facto moratorium on climate-related geoengineering pending adequate scientific basis and governance.

organizations.name: Harvard Solar Geoengineering Research Program
organizations.description: Academic program advancing interdisciplinary solar geoengineering research; originator of the SCoPEx stratospheric experiment proposal (since cancelled) and related governance work.
